owner_directive: Advance real-time race prediction in parallel now to accelerate real predictive evidence without waiting for 2026-09-18.
purpose: Create additional prospective same-day prediction evidence from races whose PRE inputs can be completely frozen before scheduled start. This is separate from R0T2-PROSPECTIVE-20260918-V1 and cannot alter or replace it.

eligible_scope.race_inclusion: Any race for which all required PRE-only fields are available and can be hashed before scheduled start; races already started or with incomplete PRE identity are excluded before any result access.

models.CR1_E05: 0.95*R0_T2 sequential probability + 0.05*sequential uniform; SHADOW ONLY, synthetic lead not promoted

required_pre_lock: entrant_score values under the existing PRE schema
hard_order: freeze and hash model outputs before start
after race completion keep result sealed until a separate exact result-scoring gate is authorized
evaluation_design: Predictions may be accumulated today, but no outcome scoring occurs under this protocol. A separate exact gate must bind the frozen lock set and minimal result parser/source before one-shot scoring.
progress_semantics: Same-day prediction locks can increase evidence readiness only after valid pre-start locks exist; 100 percent is not declared merely from activity volume or synthetic evidence.
